_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ISSUE LOG' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-05.01.

f01_ID.label: ID
f01_ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the issue (e.g., ISS-01).

f02_Type.label: Type
f02_Type.guidance: Type or classification of the issue (e.g., Technical, Resource, Schedule).

f03_Source_of_Issue.label: Source of Issue
f03_Source_of_Issue.guidance: Origin or root trigger of the issue (e.g., Vendor delay, Requirement change).

f04_Issue_Description.label: Issue Description
f04_Issue_Description.guidance: Detailed explanation of the issue and current condition.

f05_Priority.label: Priority
f05_Priority.guidance: Urgency or priority level (e.g., Urgent, High, Medium, Low).

f06_Impact_on_Objectives.label: Impact on Objectives
f06_Impact_on_Objectives.guidance: Potential or realized impact on scope, schedule, cost, or quality.

f07_Impacted_Stakeholders.label: Impacted Stakeholders
f07_Impacted_Stakeholders.guidance: Stakeholders or user groups affected by this issue.

f08_Responsible_Party.label: Responsible Party
f08_Responsible_Party.guidance: The person or role assigned to resolve or track the issue.

f09_Status.label: Status
f09_Status.guidance: Current status of the issue (e.g., Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed).

f10_Resolution_Date.label: Resolution Date
f10_Resolution_Date.guidance: Target or actual date by which the issue was resolved.

f11_Final_Resolution.label: Final Resolution
f11_Final_Resolution.guidance: Summary of the corrective action taken to resolve the issue.

f12_Comments.label: Comments
f12_Comments.guidance: Additional notes, context, or escalation details.
